description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for representing detailed information about a leave request's dates, including start and end dates, duration, and times.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDatesDetail
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates the details of leave request dates, including from and to dates, duration type, and start/end times.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize fromDate and optionally toDate.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date of the leave request.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date of the leave request.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date of the leave request, if set.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date of the leave request.

methods.name: getDurationTypeId
methods.description: Returns the ID representing the type of duration.

methods.name: setDurationTypeId
methods.description: Sets the ID representing the type of duration.

methods.name: getDurationType
methods.description: Returns the string descriptor of the duration type.

methods.name: setDurationType
methods.description: Sets the string descriptor of the duration type.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the leave, if specified.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the leave.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the leave, if specified.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time of the leave.
